blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A nationwide cleanup with over 103,000 participants has cleared 369 coastal areas of more than 466,000 kilograms of waste, according to a statement issued on Sunday by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR). That was the result of the Philippines’ participation last Saturday in this year’s International Coastal Cleanup, an activity nearly matching last year’s waste recovery level. Last year’s nationwide cleanup mobilized more than 104,000 volunteers and collected more than 466,000 kilograms of solid waste.
